TYPE: infographic

TITLE: Percentage of Employers Offering Telework Options

TEXT IN IMAGE:
Percentage of Employers Offering Telework Options
90% United States
85% China
77% India
72% United Kingdom
71% France
71% Germany
Source: Hess, Ken. “Death of the Office and Rise of the Telecommuter.” Consumerization: BYOD. ZD Net. June 2, 2014. (Some data from Intuit.)

DATA:
Donut chart graphic displaying percentages of employers offering telework options by country:
- United States: 90%
- China: 85%
- India: 77%
- United Kingdom: 72%
- France: 71%
- Germany: 71%

KEY FACTS:
- The United States has the highest percentage of employers offering telework options at 90%.
- China is second highest with 85%, followed by India at 77%.
- France and Germany share the lowest percentage displayed among the listed countries at 71% each.
